title: The 10 elements
on the
MRT
tag_line: Tag the one who stands at the door.

items.Yang Wood: Gives up their seat before anyone asks.
items.Yin Wood: Squeezes in anywhere. Somehow finds space.
items.Yang Fire: On the phone. The whole carriage hears it.
items.Yin Fire: Reading a novel. Missed their stop again.
items.Yang Earth: Same carriage, same door, every morning.
items.Yin Earth: Has a spare tissue for everyone.
items.Yang Metal: Stands at the door. Will not move in.
items.Yin Metal: Won't touch the pole. Balances like a ninja.
items.Yang Water: Takes a new route 'just to see'.
items.Yin Water: Knows which door lines up with the exit.

caption:
Tag the one who stands at the door 🚇

Every element has its MRT habit. Which one is you, and which one is your commute buddy?

Your element comes from the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find yours free at the link in bio.

Which one are you? Comment below.
